vulkanmod.options.advCulling.tooltip: Use a culling algorithm that might improve performance by reducing the number of non visible chunk sections rendered.
vulkanmod.options.ao.subBlock.tooltip: Enables smooth lighting for non full block (experimental).
vulkanmod.options.entityCulling.tooltip: Enables culling for entities on not visible sections.
vulkanmod.options.frameQueue.tooltip: Higher values might help stabilize frametime but will increase input lag.
vulkanmod.options.backfaceCulling.toolti: Culls not visible block faces on the CPU improving GPU performance. To prevent increased CPU overhead enable Indirect Draw.
vulkanmod.options.indirectDraw.tooltip: Reduces CPU overhead but might increase GPU overhead.
vulkanmod.options.hudCache.tooltip: Reuses the previous frame's HUD vertex buffers when nothing on screen changed, skipping the per-frame GUI rebuild and upload. Animations keep playing; disable only if you see HUD glitches.
vulkanmod.options.directUploads.tooltip: Writes vertex data straight into GPU-visible memory on integrated graphics (UMA), skipping the staging buffer copy and halving upload bandwidth. Has no effect on buffers that are not host-mappable. Disable if you suspect upload corruption.
vulkanmod.options.throttleFarRebuilds.to: Limits how many distant chunk sections are rebuilt per frame, so bursts of far-away updates (lighting, worldgen) can't stall rebuilds right in front of you. Deferred sections are rebuilt on later frames, closest first.
vulkanmod.options.maxFarRebuilds.tooltip: Maximum distant chunk sections scheduled for rebuild each frame. Lower values smooth frametimes during heavy world updates; higher values make far terrain changes appear sooner.
vulkanmod.options.nearRebuildDistance.to: Sections within this distance (in blocks) are always rebuilt immediately and never throttled.
vulkanmod.options.vsyncFramePacing.toolt: Paces the CPU to the display refresh rate while VSync is on, preventing the render thread from stalling at unpredictable points. Smooths frame delivery and reduces input lag.
vulkanmod.options.uniqueOpaqueLayer.tool: Use a unique render layer for opaque terrain to improve performance.
vulkanmod.options.wayland.tooltip: Use Linux Wayland compositor if available (Experimental). Requires restart.
